title: The Lord's Accusation Against Israel

questions.question: There is no faithfulness or steadfast love, and no knowledge of whom in the land?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:1 (ESV): "There is no faithfulness or steadfast love, and no knowledge of God in the land;"

questions.question: My people are destroyed for lack of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:6 (ESV): "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge;"

questions.question: Because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from being a what to me?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:6 (ESV): "Because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from being a priest to me."

questions.question: They feed on the sin of my people; they are greedy for their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:8 (ESV): "They feed on the sin of my people; they are greedy for their iniquity."

questions.question: Whoredom, wine, and new wine take away what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:11 (ESV): "Whoredom, wine, and new wine, which take away the understanding."

questions.question: There is swearing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break all bounds, and what follows?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:2 (ESV): "they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed."

questions.question: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it languish, and also the beasts of the field and the...?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:3 (ESV): "and also the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens;"

questions.question: And it shall be like people, like who?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:9 (ESV): "And it shall be like people, like priest;"

questions.question: My people inquire of a piece of wood, and their what gives them oracles?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:12 (ESV): "My people inquire of a piece of wood, and their walking staff gives them oracles."

questions.question: Though you play the whore, O Israel, let not whom become guilty?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:15 (ESV): "Though you play the whore, O Israel, let not Judah become guilty."

questions.question: With whom is the Lord contending?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:1 (ESV): "for the Lord has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land."

questions.question: Who has stumbled in the night, and the prophet stumbles with him by day?
options: You no longer mentioned by name, but implied priest
questions.correctAnswer: You no longer mentioned by name, but implied priest
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:5 (ESV): "You shall stumble by day; the prophet also shall stumble with you by night; and I will destroy your mother."

questions.question: Who is joined to idols?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:17 (ESV): "Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone."

questions.question: A spirit of what has led them astray?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:12 (ESV): "For a spirit of whoredom has led them astray,"

questions.question: Where are they told not to go up to?
questions.explanation: Hosea 4:15 (ESV): "Enter not into Gilgal, nor go up to Beth-aven,"

key_verse_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; because you have rejected knowledge, I reject you from being a priest to me. And since you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children.
